title: CSS: Use a post-processor
body:
Not needed right now for the `default.css` theme, but we're going to need some better tooling when we'll start doing more advanced themes (in order to handle cross-browser compatibility) and expose some colors/spacing as variable for users to build their own themes.

This should fit in the Webpack build process.

(I thought we had an issue about it already but could not find it)
